tests.exercises: zero-beta 2D (nr 105, nt 100, np 3) analytic Alfven wave in theta (ALFVEN_WAVE1, modes r 2, t 3, amplitude 1e-4) to t 15 with viscosity 1e-5 and no resistivity: the vector-potential advance and the semi-implicit velocity solve
tests.why: damped wave, deterministic, 602 history rows; graded on the mas_history_a.out energy columns and the final br field; reproduced the PSI reference to 6 digits

tests.exercises: zero-beta 3D (25x50x100) tilted Alfven wave in phi (ALFVEN_WAVE2_ROTATED) to t 3: the full 3D advance with a phi-periodic mesh and the pole filter
tests.why: deterministic; longest suite deck (35 s on 1 rank); graded on the history columns and final fields; reproduced to 6 digits

tests.exercises: zero-beta 3D (41x31x61) potential field from a Bastille-day map (br_map_input.h5) with three TDm flux ropes inserted (rho_bastille_test_reduced.h5), 20 steps at dtmax 0.001: the TDm rope insertion and the first steps of the relaxation
tests.why: deterministic, ntmax 20; graded on the history columns and the final field; reproduced to 6 digits

tests.exercises: zero-beta 3D (41x31x61) dipole with an RBSL flux rope built from three path files (torus, mirrored north, mirrored south), 10 steps: the Regularized Biot-Savart Laws insertion that CORHEL-CME uses
tests.why: deterministic, ntmax 10; 1 and 4 ranks identical to 12 digits; graded on the history columns and the final field; reproduced to 6 digits

tests.exercises: polytropic 3D (51x35x71) relaxation from a Parker 1D profile (initial_plasma_1d_r_parker1.8.dat) with WKB pressure waves (advance_pw) to t 2 and two in-situ history probes
tests.why: deterministic; graded on mas_history_a.out, the in-situ histories and the final fields; reproduced to 6 digits

tests.exercises: thermodynamic 3D (51x31x61, r 1 to 20) relaxation with anisotropic thermal conduction (advance_tc), radiative losses and heating from a 1D profile to t 0.5, with tp slices
tests.why: deterministic for a fixed rank count; 4 ranks vs 1 rank differ at 1e-8 relative, so the check fixes mpi_ranks; graded on history columns, slices and final fields; reproduced to 6 digits

tests.exercises: thermodynamic 3D (61x31x61) relaxation with the wave-turbulence-driven model (advance_zw): WTD flux mask, zw limit table, a 3D initial density at 1 AU (rho3d_initial_1au_rho40k.h5) and the rho40k 1D profile
tests.why: deterministic for a fixed rank count (same solver family as thermo-3d-relaxation); graded on history columns, slices and final fields; reproduced to 6 digits

tests.exercises: heliospheric 2D (201x61x3) relaxation from r0 30 Rs with time-dependent boundary files in bc/ (br, rho, t, vr slices), dtmax 100 to t 100: the inner-heliosphere driver with file boundaries
tests.why: deterministic; 1 and 4 ranks identical to 12 digits; 266 history rows; graded on the history columns and the final fields; reproduced to 6 digits

tests.exercises: CORHEL masp polytropic coronal relaxation from the CR2124 HMI synoptic map (potential-field start, Parker 1D profile), the deck's own physics at a reduced grid and a short window
tests.why: the production deck (201x151x257, tmax 150) costs minutes per step; the check keeps the deck's physics switches and inputs and reduces nr, nt, np and ntmax (measured 2.8 s for 5 steps at 61x51x91 on 4 ranks; the check window is set at calibration under the 300 s rule); no reference shipped, the pinned build generates it

tests.exercises: CORHEL thermodynamic coronal relaxation with Heating Model 1: potential field from the CR2124 map, thermal conduction, radiative losses, pressure waves, heat and emission outputs
tests.why: production deck 255x143x300; same reduction as the polytropic deck (measured 3.0 s for 5 steps at 61x51x91 on 4 ranks); pinned-build reference; the HM1 heating path is exercised by no testsuite deck

tests.exercises: CORHEL thermodynamic coronal relaxation with Heating Model 2 and the closed-field heating mask closed_field_mask_pfss.h5
tests.why: production deck 255x143x300, runtime estimated from the HM1 deck at the same reduction (not yet run natively); HM2 with a heat mask is exercised by no other deck; pinned-build reference

tests.exercises: thermodynamic HM1 relaxation of a tilted dipole (DIPOLE initial field, no input map), tmax 2.49
tests.why: production deck 231x125x217, runtime estimated from the HM1 deck (not yet run natively); the DIPOLE start with HM1 heating is exercised by no other deck; pinned-build reference

tests.exercises: inner-heliosphere polytropic relaxation from 30 Rs driven by WSA boundary files (bc/, from SWiG), corotating frame, tmax 600
tests.why: production deck 500x157x361; measured 1.1 s for 5 steps at 61x51x91 on 4 ranks; pinned-build reference; bc/ symlinks must be preserved when the deck is copied into the check

tests.exercises: inner-heliosphere relaxation from 30 Rs driven by boundary slices of a thermodynamic HM1 coronal run (bc/slice_tp001_*.h5)
tests.why: production deck 500x157x361, runtime estimated from the WSA deck (not yet run natively); the coronal-slice boundary reader is exercised by no other deck; pinned-build reference
